      public static final String CFR_NAME
      The name of the Counterfactual Regret Minimization (CFR) agent, which is "DeepCFR". This name is used for identification and description purposes within the game.

    • AgentCFR

      public AgentCFR()
      Constructs a new instance of the AgentCFR class, initializing it with the unique identifier and filename for the Counterfactual Regret Minimization (CFR) agent. This constructor sets up the necessary parameters for the agent to function within the poker game environment.
